TropicPort Terms of Use

Version 1.1 — Last updated: November 17, 2026

1. Introduction and Acceptance

These Terms of Use (the "Terms") form a binding agreement between you ("you", "your" or "User") and TropicPort ("TropicPort", "we", "our" or "us") and govern your access to and use of the TropicPort platform, including the TropicPort Telegram Mini App, website, associated Telegram bots and any related services, features and tools (collectively, the "Service").

You accept and become bound by these Terms upon any of the following actions: opening, accessing or using the Service in any way; connecting a wallet or making a deposit; buying, selling, listing, transferring or making an offer for any Digital Item; participating in any referral, points, season or other promotional program; purchasing Telegram Stars or Telegram Premium.

If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not access or use the Service. Continued use of the Service after any amendment to these Terms constitutes acceptance of the amended Terms.

2. The Service

TropicPort is a digital marketplace for Telegram Gifts — digital collectible items existing within the Telegram ecosystem ("Digital Items" or "Gifts").

The Service may include, among other features: browsing, buying, selling, listing and transferring Digital Items, including individual and collection-wide offers; an internal account balance and deposits and withdrawals of GRAM; purchases of Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium; promotional programs such as referral rewards, points and seasons.

We may add, modify, suspend, restrict or remove any feature of the Service at any time, with or without notice. Nothing in these Terms obligates TropicPort to maintain any particular feature.

3. Eligibility

By accessing or using the Service, you represent, warrant and undertake on a continuing basis that: you are at least eighteen (18) years of age (or the age of legal majority in your jurisdiction, if higher) and have full legal capacity to enter into these Terms; you are not subject to sanctions administered by OFAC, the United Nations, the European Union, the United Kingdom or any other applicable sanctions authority, and you are not listed on any list of prohibited or restricted persons; your access to and use of the Service is lawful in your jurisdiction, and you have verified this before using the Service; you use your own Telegram account and act on your own behalf, not for the benefit of any third party; all information you provide is accurate and current.

You are solely responsible for determining whether your use of the Service complies with the laws and regulations applicable to you.

4. Digital Items; No Value Guarantee

All items available on the Service are digital goods. They exist only in digital form, are recorded within the Service or the Telegram ecosystem and may be transferred between users.

The value of Digital Items is determined solely by users and market conditions. TropicPort does not guarantee the current or future value, liquidity, transferability or availability of any Digital Item. Digital Items are not investment products, securities or financial instruments, and nothing in the Service should be understood as creating an expectation of profit.

Any prices, floor prices, valuations or estimates displayed in the Service are informational estimates only and are not guaranteed to be accurate, current or achievable.

5. Balance, Deposits and Withdrawals

The Service maintains an internal account balance for each user, denominated in GRAM or such other units as displayed in the interface. Your balance is an internal ledger record used to pay for and receive proceeds from activity within the Service.

Cryptocurrency only. All balances, prices, deposits, withdrawals, payments, fees and settlements within the Service are denominated and settled exclusively in cryptocurrency (GRAM). TropicPort does not accept, hold, process or pay out any fiat currency — including rubles, hryvnias, US dollars, euros or any other national currency — and does not accept payments by bank card, bank transfer or any other fiat payment method.

Deposits are made from supported third-party wallets and are credited after confirmation on the TON blockchain. Withdrawals are processed after security and compliance checks and may be delayed or declined where fraud, abuse or unlawful activity is suspected. Blockchain network fees are borne by you and are non-refundable. Your balance is not a bank deposit, electronic money or an interest-bearing account, and no interest accrues on it. Blockchain transactions are irreversible; you are solely responsible for the accuracy of any wallet address you provide, and TropicPort cannot recover assets sent to an incorrect address.

6. Marketplace Rules, Fees and Commissions

Prices for Digital Items are set by the users listing them. TropicPort charges a fee of 1% on sales made through the Service. Any other fees and commissions for certain transactions and features are displayed in the interface and are applied as in effect at the time of the relevant transaction. Fees may change prospectively at any time.

Offers you place are binding on you while active and may be accepted by the counterparty at any time before cancellation. Transactions between users are final upon execution and cannot be reversed by TropicPort at a user's request. TropicPort may cancel or unwind transactions resulting from technical errors, malfunctions, exploits or fraud.

7. Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium

The Service may allow you to purchase Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium subscriptions. Such purchases are fulfilled through third-party infrastructure within the Telegram ecosystem and are delivered directly to the Telegram account you specify.

You are solely responsible for the accuracy of the recipient username; delivery to the account you specified is proper fulfilment. Purchases are final and non-refundable once delivered. Displayed prices are denominated in GRAM (cryptocurrency) and include service markups. Availability of Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium may vary by region and depends on third-party services outside TropicPort's control.

8. Payments and Refunds

All payments within the Service are made exclusively in cryptocurrency (GRAM). TropicPort does not accept fiat currency in any form — no rubles, no hryvnias, no other national currencies — and does not process payments by bank card, bank transfer or similar fiat payment methods. If any price is ever shown converted into a fiat currency, that figure is an informational estimate only; the actual payment, settlement and any refund are always made in cryptocurrency.

Due to the nature of digital goods, all purchases and transactions are final. Refunds may be considered only in limited cases: duplicate payments; payment processing errors; technical failures attributable to the Service that prevented delivery of a purchased item.

No refunds are provided for changes in the value of Digital Items. Refund requests must be submitted to @TropicPortSupportBot. Any refund is made in the same cryptocurrency in which the original payment was made.

9. Promotional Programs

Referral rewards, points, seasons and other promotional programs are discretionary. Their rules, rates and availability are as displayed in the interface and may be modified, suspended or discontinued at any time, provided that changes are not applied retroactively to rewards validly earned, except where required by law or where rewards were obtained through prohibited conduct.

TropicPort may withhold, reduce, reverse or cancel any accrual or reward that results from fraud, self-referrals, multi-accounting, artificial activity, manipulation or any other breach of these Terms.

10. Prohibited Conduct

You agree not to, and not to permit any other person to: use the Service for any unlawful, fraudulent or abusive purpose, including in violation of sanctions, anti-money laundering or other applicable laws; manipulate markets or prices, including through wash trading, collusion, self-dealing or exploitation of errors or vulnerabilities; use bots, scrapers or other automated tools, except automation features expressly provided by the Service; create or use multiple accounts to abuse promotions, evade restrictions or manipulate any feature; interfere with, disrupt or attempt to gain unauthorised access to the Service or its infrastructure, or reverse engineer any part of the Service except where permitted by mandatory law; impersonate any person or misrepresent your identity, location or affiliation.

TropicPort may investigate suspected violations, suspend or terminate access, withhold associated proceeds obtained through violations and report activity to competent authorities where required.

Nothing in the Service constitutes legal, tax, financial or investment advice, or a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any Digital Item or digital asset.

You acknowledge that digital assets and blockchain technologies involve substantial risk, including price volatility, loss of liquidity, technology and cybersecurity risk, regulatory risk and the risk of total loss of value. Transactions are generally irreversible. You assume all risks associated with your use of the Service and may lose the entire amount of any assets committed through it.
